description: This file defines constants, functions, and markers related to authentication methods and environment variable markers for model agents, including OAuth, secret references, and cloud provider credentials.

methods.name: isAwsSdkAuthMarker
methods.description: Checks if a given value is an AWS SDK environment marker.

methods.name: isKnownEnvApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Determines if a value is a known environment API key marker, excluding AWS SDK markers.

methods.name: resolveOAuthApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth API key marker string for a given provider ID.

methods.name: isOAuthApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Checks if a value is an OAuth API key marker.

methods.name: resolveNonEnvSecretRefApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Returns the non-environment secret reference marker string.

methods.name: resolveNonEnvSecretRefHeaderValueMarker
methods.description: Returns the non-environment secret reference header value marker string.

methods.name: resolveEnvSecretRefHeaderValueMarker
methods.description: Constructs a secret reference environment variable header value marker string.

methods.name: isSecretRefHeaderValueMarker
methods.description: Checks if a value is a secret reference header value marker.

methods.name: isNonSecretApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Determines if a value is a recognized non-secret API key marker, optionally including environment variable names.
